```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
devtools::load_all()

n_sim <- 10000

method_colors <- c(
  "z.test.gaussian"      = "#E41A1C",
  "z.test.oracle.kappa"  = "#377EB8",
  "bs.multiplier"        = "#4DAF4A",
  "bs.parametric"        = "#FF7F00",
  "bs.parametric.psd"    = "#0072B2",
  "z.test.null"          = "#984EA3",
  "z.test.null.gaussian" = "#A65628"
)
```

## $p = 2$: Z-Test Methods

```{r}
#| cache: true
params_p2 <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential")

pvals_z_p2 <- list(
  "Z-Test (Gaussian)"       = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.gaussian",      n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test (Oracle κ₂₂)"    = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.oracle.kappa",  n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test (Null)"           = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.null",          n_sim = n_sim),
  "Z-Test (Null, Gaussian)" = pcurve(params_p2, "z.test.null.gaussian", n_sim = n_sim)
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_z_p2, title = "p = 2 — Scenario 2 (L = 4), exponential errors, σ = (1, 1)")
```

## $p = 2$: Bootstrap Methods

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| dependson: "params_p2"
pvals_bs_p2 <- list(
  "Bootstrap (Multiplier)"      = pcurve(params_p2, "bs.multiplier",     n_sim = n_sim),
  "Bootstrap (Parametric, PSD)" = pcurve(params_p2, "bs.parametric.psd", n_sim = n_sim)
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_pcurve(pvals_bs_p2, title = "p = 2 — Scenario 2 (L = 4), exponential errors, σ = (1, 1)")
```

## $p > 2$: Bootstrap Methods

```{r}
#| cache: true
params_p3  <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential", p = 3)
params_p5  <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential", p = 5)
params_p10 <- scenario(2, L = 4, n = 1000, err_type = "exponential", p = 10)

pvals_bs_pg2 <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(c("bs.multiplier", "bs.parametric.psd"), \(m)
    tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p3,  m, n_sim = n_sim), p = 3,  method = m)),
  map_dfr(c("bs.multiplier", "bs.parametric.psd"), \(m)
    tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p5,  m, n_sim = n_sim), p = 5,  method = m)),
  map_dfr(c("bs.multiplier", "bs.parametric.psd"), \(m)
    tibble(p_value = pcurve(params_p10, m, n_sim = n_sim), p = 10, method = m))
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
method_labels_bs <- c(
  "bs.multiplier"     = "Bootstrap (Multiplier)",
  "bs.parametric.psd" = "Bootstrap (Parametric, PSD)"
)

pvals_bs_pg2 |>
  mutate(
    method = method_labels_bs[method],
    p      = factor(p, labels = c("p = 3", "p = 5", "p = 10"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = p_value)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
                 fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_grid(p ~ method) +
  labs(x = "p-value", y = "Density",
       title = "p > 2 — Scenario 2 (L = 4), exponential errors") +
  theme_minimal()
```
